title: Hatsune Miku — That Glint In Your Eye〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Phew... Today's practice felt really good♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Could it be because I tried copying the way Shizuku uses her body as she poses?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (She was so stunning during that shoot...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (She took a hard look at her old self and practiced like there was no tomorrow...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (The shoot apparently went very well for that commercial, so I'm glad that everything paid off in the end for her.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, that reminds me... I promised Shizuku and the others that I'd meet them today.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I think I'll head over to where they are now.
Shopping Mall

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Hi, everyone!>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Miku...!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Sorry, I hope I didn't make you all wait.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
No, your timing couldn't have been better!
We were just about to come grab you.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <So, what's on today's agenda?>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, so... There's something we'd like for you to see, Miku.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <You want me to see something?>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, starting with these!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Wow...! These gemstones are beautiful...!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
They really are.
But they're actually a type of Japanese crystal candy called kohakuto.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Wait, really?>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Really!
They even come in a variety of shapes and colors like real gems!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: We even got to try them a second ago, and they were really good♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <They were...?! Then, I'd also love to try some.>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. I think they're going to really love these.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We're actually going to throw Shizuku a party to congratulate her on her commercial's success.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: We came here to buy some sweets for then, but we also wanted to get you and the others some gifts, Miku.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, because you all took the time to watch me practice, gave me wonderful advice and helped me in many other ways...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Which is why I'd like to thank you all somehow.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <I see. Then, if you don't mind, would you mind getting some of these for us?>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Of course. We have a very wide selection of Japanese sweets available to us here, so let's choose together.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<Sounds good!
Let's find some sweets that Rin and the others are going to really love♪>
Stage SEKAI - Flower Field

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Here, Rin!
These sweets are for you!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Wow! They're so colorful, shiny and pretty...! Are these really edible?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Yes, they're called kohakuto!
We chose them because you always bring so much glittery energy to the stage, Rin♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Thanks, Miku!
I promise to savor every bite!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: We'll need to thank the others for helping you pick out these wonderful gifts for us.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: They're throwing that party for Shizuku now, right?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes. They're having it over at the MORE MORE HOUSE so their manager can also join.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'm here in their place to pass out the sweets we got you all.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
I see.
Then, for now, why don't we start having these?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Wait, what did you get Luka?
It looks like really pretty flowers...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
They're called rakugan.
We chose them because Luka blooms like a beautiful flower whenever she performs on stage♪

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Oh, that's so kind of you.
And there are so many different kinds. It's like a little flower field inside a box♪

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: What did you get for MEIKO? They look like manju shaped like cats. Are these also based on the way she performs on stage?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes, we had to pick them because their adorable smiles immediately reminded us of her!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Hehe. Thank you!
I don't know what to say.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: And I haven't forgotten about you guys, Len, KAITO! We worked really hard to pick these out, so I hope you'll love them.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Thank you for choosing such wonderful gifts for us. So, why don't we see how these taste?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Still...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Thank goodness Shizuku's shoot ended up going so well.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: And the commercial turned out beautifully!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You were probably the happiest out of all of us, weren't you, Miku?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You were the first one to go over and watch her practice.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Oh...
*Nod*

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That's right...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Not bad...
But I can still do better.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (With each successive practice, she learned to shine brighter and brighter...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (I honestly couldn't wait to see where she was going to end up.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (And then, in that commercial, she completely blew me away. She was more beautiful than I could've ever imagined...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (Thank goodness all her hard work ended up paying off. And I'm extremely glad that I got to see her shine the way she did.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, this feeling reminds me of...!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
...?
Umm... Is there some red bean paste or something stuck to my face, Miku?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: No. I think I'm starting to understand why your eyes glimmer whenever we succeed at something, KAITO♪

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: What? I really appreciate you saying that, but I also feel a little embarrassed...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (If I'm going to become an even more spectacular idol than I already am...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (Then I also need to keep finding ways to get better.)
